text:
Emma: Heads-up — config-only tweak to runtime batching ready for deploy. Change window tonight 22:00 PST. Question: patch (x.y.z) or minor (x.y+1.0)?

Kai: patch. no API, no public surface change, just defaults.

Tyler: Agree with Kai. Also needs lockfile sync in the artifact, but that doesn't force a minor.

Sara: We'll need a release note: one-liner + link to the changelog PR. I'll add after CI passes.

Emma: Quick policy question — do we pin production routes to `v1.4.3` or `v1.4.3+ci1234`? Ops prefers stable tags for rollbacks.

Jordan: Ops preference is stable semver tag on the registry (no buildmeta). Put CI build metadata in the artifact metadata store and release notes. Keeps `kubectl rollout undo` friendly.

Maria: Rollback criteria we agreed last month? Is it still >=5% errors in 15m or 10% in 5m?

Kai: Still the same: >=5% errors sustained for 15m -> automatic rollback. Deploy-bot will trigger.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled at 22:00 PST. Canary size: 5% traffic. Health checks: 200 ok rate >= 99.5%, latency p95 < 400ms.

Tyler: For tagging syntax suggestion: keep tags like `v1.4.3` and use `v1.4.3+ci.20260320` only in CI logs/artifacts. Example we use everywhere: 
```
# tag in git & registry
$ git tag -a v1.4.3 -m "patch: runtime batching defaults"
$ docker tag image:sha image:v1.4.3

# CI artifact metadata (NOT the runtime tag)
build.id=ci.20260320
```

Sara: +1. Release note draft posted in the PR description.

Emma: What about backport/cherry-pick rules? If a fix is config-only, do we still open release PRs against stable branch?

Jordan: Yes — create a patch branch `release/1.4.x` and cherry-pick. Keep commit message prepended with `cherry-pick:` so release-bot includes it in changelog.

release-bot: Noted. Will include cherry-picked commits with prefix `cherry-pick:` in the generated changelog for the patch release.

Maria: If the canary fails via increased errors, who's on-call to approve immediate rollback?

Kai: Ops on-call (Jordan) auto-rollback; if rollback fails, escalate to eng-oncall (Emma).

Emma: Sounds good. I'll flip the deploy window to go-ahead. I will also add the one-line to prod notes and pin the production route to `v1.4.3` (no buildmeta). :thumbsup:

Tyler: Quick nit: annotate release notes with config toggles changed, and the default values that changed. Easier to audit later.

Sara: Doing that now. PR link: https://git.redwood/example/PR/4567

Kai: Final: patch bump, tag `v1.4.3`, pin stable route. Deploy-bot will run canary and rollback on the 5%/15m threshold.

Emma: Thanks. closing thread after deploy completes.
